request.purpose: Audit SQL2 tables for last metadata update and size to identify tables not updated in at least one week
request.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,ENGINE,TABLE_ROWS,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_TIME,ROUND((DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024,2) total_mb FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY COALESCE(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME),TABLE_NAME
